jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Heart Health
jobs.description: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager – Heart Health to join our growing Health Sensing organization. Reporting to the Director of Product Management, Health Risk Detection, this role will focus on advancing Oura’s cardiovascular health experiences, from proactive monitoring to long-term heart health insights. You’ll join an established, cross-functional team dedicated to Heart Health. You’ll collaborate with Science, Design, Engineering, and Regulatory partners to accelerate our roadmap, deepen member value, and bring science-backed heart health features to life. This is a high-impact opportunity to help shape how millions of people understand and care for their cardiovascular health through wearable technology. This remote role is open to candidates residing in the Eastern Time Zone and requires periodic travel to Boston, MA. What You’ll Do Partner closely with Science and Engineering teams to define and deliver next-generation heart health sensing and signal analysis capabilities Translate scientific findings and physiological concepts into intuitive, meaningful product experiences that empower members to better understand their heart health Support discovery and development of new features spanning both wellness and regulated use cases Contribute to the prioritization and delivery of roadmap initiatives,

jobs.title: Senior Registered Veterinary Nurse
jobs.description: At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners. We are seeking a confident, knowledgeable Senior Veterinary Nurse to join our team at Otter Vets on a full-time basis. Otter Vets has two branches based in the coastal town of Sidmouth and the market town of Ottery St Mary in Devon. We’re well established within our local community and regularly get involved in charity events, from our fun dog show and coffee mornings to Christmas advent calendars. You’ll be joining a friendly and supportive team, working alongside two experienced senior nurses and having the opportunity to get involved across all areas of first opinion nursing. How You’ll Make a Difference As a Senior Veterinary Nurse, you will play a key role in delivering high standards of nursing care while supporting and developing colleagues within the practice. You’ll work collaboratively with veterinary surgeons and the wider practice team to support excellent patient and client care. You'll also act as a source of guidance for the nursing team and contribute to maintaining and improving clinical standards, workflows and patient outcomes. Working Pattern * 40 hours per week however we are open to part-time applications. Can adapt to suit school hours or set days a week. * 4 days per week between 8:00am and 6:00pm * 1:4 Saturday mornings from 8:30am to 1:00pm * No Sunday working * No out-of-hours requirement General Responsibilities * Running nurse clinics * Providing outstanding inpatient care * Assisting with laboratory work and diagnostic imaging * Monitoring anaesthesia and supporting surgical procedures * Supporting with reception duties when required You Might Be a Great Fit If... You are an experienced and confident Registered Veterinary Nurse who enjoys supporting others and leading by example. You’ll bring: * Registration

jobs.title: Senior Branch Nurse
jobs.description: At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners. We are looking for an enthusiastic and experienced RVN to join us as Senior Branch Nurse and lead our Tadley Surgery. This is a fantastic opportunity for an RVN looking to take the next step in their career and play an important role in the leadership and development of our friendly Tadley team. Donnington Grove Veterinary Group is an established three-branch practice, with our main RCVS Tier 3 Hospital in Newbury and branches in Thatcham and Tadley. We have a large and varied client base, a supportive nursing team and excellent opportunities for professional development. We encourage our nurses to develop their own interests and pursue further qualifications. We have a team of 17 vets, including certificate holders in small animal surgery, ophthalmology and exotics, as well as vets with an interest in internal medicine. This makes us more than a first-opinion practice as we often perform surgeries and treat cases that may otherwise have been referred. Having been established for decades, and with two branch practices in Thatcham and Tadley, we have a huge client base which comes with lots of variety in our caseload. Our nursing team is made up of 15 RVNs and 8 SVNs in various stages of their training. We are supported by a team of 7 nursing assistants. We also have a dedicated team of 3 night nurses. We encourage our nurses to pursue special interests as much as possible; for example, we currently have nurses studying towards nutrition and small animal medicine certificates How You’ll Make a Difference As Senior Branch Nurse, you will provide day-to-day leadership to the nursing team while remaining hands-on clinically. jobs.title: Laboratory technician
jobs.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us! Position overview Orakl Oncology works on a large cohort of patient-derived organoids (PDO) to predict clinical outcomes of patients and derisk clinical trials. We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Lab Technician to help us execute large-scale drug screening assays on our semi-automated platform, either for internal or external projects. In this position, you will: Actively participate in our commercial contracts: you will take care of numerous PDOs of interest and perform drug screening assays to generate high-quality, robust datasets. These results will be leveraged by our data science and computational biology teams to deliver actionable insights and decision-support data to our partners. Work on the expansion of the Orakl biobank: you will work on patient specimens and organoid cell lines to increase the amount of data
